items.topic: Lateral lumbar interbody fusion: psoas weakness versus femoral neuropathy
items.destination_intent: Spine 2026 teaching note when OITE logging is requested
items.teaching_point_placement: Adjacent to the Q78 discriminator between isolated hip-flexion weakness and a broader femoral nerve deficit
items.caption_intent: Exact uploaded 2025 OITE Q78 screenshot with postoperative L4-L5 AP and lateral radiographs. The bank interprets the cage as lateral placement; isolated 4/5 hip-flexion weakness favors approach-related psoas dysfunction, while femoral injury remains possible and is better supported by quadriceps, reflex, and sensory findings.
